author: nickzulu3
body:
TeamSpeak, In-game, Slack?: In-game

Staff Member: Arigenn

Guilty? (Yes or No): Yes I am guilty

Why do you think you should be unbanned?: I ban evaded on multiple accounts and I very much regret my decision to do that. In these past 4 months that I have been banned I have wanted to come play on Avic and I've realised how much that was a stupid thing to do. Also when me and my friend LowkeyWaterPolo were going on our rampage we were rude to a couple mods on the server and I apologize deeply for doing that, it would mean the world to me if you guys could give me a second chance on the server to play fair and be nice to everyone because I will do exactly that and I hope you mode believe me in saying this. Thank you for your time and I hope to see all of you on the server soon! -Nick

Any additional comments?: Shoutout to Strucken ;)

replies.body: I would like to have my appeal escalated, Arigenn (the person who banned me) is inactive.

replies.author: AstroPizza
replies.body:
I apologize for the long wait time for your appeal , shouldn't have happened.

As much as we appreciate your apology and the fact you understand what you have done wrong 
we typically don't appeal ban evading till 6+ months - similar to hacking - all situational.
Appeal again in 1-2 months and your appeal will have a lot higher chance.

Appeal Denied
